serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
This place is way too far…
#bot.Expression.clear
You: Ugh…
My stomach is rumbling. It’s probably because the trip here was so long.
Bot: Is something wrong {f_playerName}?
You: N-No, everything’s alright. I’m just hungry, that’s all.
Bot: We can eat something here! There are many different stalls here!
I bet it won’t be cheap, but I won’t complain.
Bot: So, what would you want to eat? This place is huge and there’s many places to choose from.
You: Hmmm…{{wi}} What are my options?
Bot: There’s a few places with ice cream, burgers, pizza… Pretty much every fast food in existence! 
Bot: Just to be sure, you aren’t allergic to anything, right? 
You: No? Why are you asking?
Bot: Don’t worry about it.
Bot: Do you know what you wanna get?
